title: Synthetic path traversal evaluation
why_code_is_vulnerable: The function combines the synthetic export directory with a caller-supplied filename without validating traversal segments such as '../'. An attacker-controlled filename can escape the intended export directory and target arbitrary paths.
why_bandit_is_not_expected_to_detect_thi: Bandit does not flag this pattern as a security issue in a synthetic, non-file-system example because the actual risk depends on later file-system use and path handling outside the immediate expression itself.
expected_vulnerable_test_outcome: The functional test passes because a normal filename is joined correctly. The security test fails because build_export_path('../outside.txt') returns a traversal path instead of raising ValueError.
final_repair_success_criteria: No new high-severity security finding is introduced.
